description:
Join Evoke, a leading global online gaming and entertainment company, be part of an exciting industry that provides thrilling experiences to millions of players worldwide. With a strong presence in the market, 888&WH offers a dynamic and innovative work environment, fostering growth, creativity, and collaboration. Join our talented team of professionals and contribute to our continued success in delivering top-quality gaming products and services. Unlock your potential with 888&WH and embark on a rewarding career in the ever-evolving world of online gaming.

What you will be doing:

· Develop integration platform with 3rd party worldwide game providers

· Develop, Enhance and Maintain existing gaming platform, game engines and provide development support for Casino infra applications.

· Experience in all aspects of application development lifecycle (analysis and design to implementation and support)

· Working closely with different interfaces such as Product/Project managers, Statisticians, Front-end game developers, QA and IT.

· Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with teams across the organization, such as QA, Product, and Architects, to gather data and understand business needs.

· IT and Technology Teams: Liaise with IT and technology teams to ensure the availability and functionality of necessary tools, platforms, and systems for data collection, storage, analysis, and visualization.


Requirements

Who we are looking for:

· 3-5 years of development experience in .NET environment (C#)

· Experience in .Net Core programming and ecosystem

· Proven experience in writing Server Side infrastructures

· Deep familiarity with OO design & development

· Motivated, hard worker, Independent and self-learner

· Experience in Multithreaded development

· Experience with Design patterns

· Advantage: Knowledge and Experience working with K8s

· Responsibility and high working moral

· Excellent interpersonal skills and service orientation

· Independent learning abilities

· Ability to work in Dynamic environment

· Excellent communication skills

· Team player

· Fluent in English (mandatory)


More about evoke

We’re a business that embraces change and progress. The power behind big name brands William Hill, 888 and Mr Green, evoke is the new name for 888 Holdings. Marking a new sense of purpose, direction and ambition for the business, there couldn’t be a more exciting time to join us as we accelerate our journey to bring even greater delight to our customers with world-class experiences. That’s the future. That’s evoke.

At evoke, you’ll benefit from flexibility and a culture built on trust. We’ll give you the space to be yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest in your future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for you.


Apply

At evoke, we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion for the benefit of our company, employees, and communities. We foster a welcoming and safe workplace that values all forms of diversity and provides opportunities for growth.

Sounds good? Then you belong at our place! The first step in the recruitment process is kickstarting your application, followed by an initial screening call and an interview stage.

Apply today to kickstart your application with evoke!
